hero:
TRAINING STEP · VISUAL MODULE MAP

One step: make a prediction, measure the mistake, adjust the network.

Ordinarily one batch leads to one update. With gradient accumulation, several batch iterations can feed a single optimizer step.

Common PyTorch Order: model.train() → optimizer.zero_grad() → predictions=model(inputs) → loss=criterion(predictions,targets) → loss.backward() → optimizer.step(). train() Dropout/BatchNorm Behavior Set చేస్తుంది. zero_grad Old Gradients Clear చేయడానికి Necessary.

03 · The internal mechanism

Backpropagation computes gradients before the optimizer changes weights

Gradients accumulate by default; clear them at the right time unless intentionally accumulating over several mini-batches.

06 · Scaling to large networks

Several micro-batches can combine into one optimizer update

For FP16 AMP, unscale accumulated gradients before clipping. Scheduler timing and DDP synchronization must match the chosen update boundary.
